name: Dialogue OS
install: if [ -f .cursor/install.sh ]; then bash .cursor/install.sh; else bash repos/dialogue-os/.cursor/install.sh; fi

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: for d in ../yta-assistant-travel-memory repos/yta-assistant-travel-memory /agent/repos/yta-assistant-travel-memory; do [ -d "$d" ] && cd "$d" && break; done && . .venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: YTA-ASSISTANT FastAPI backend on http://localhost:8000 (health, memory, flights/hotels/cars endpoints).

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: for d in ../your-travel-agent-ccb6b77f repos/your-travel-agent-ccb6b77f /agent/repos/your-travel-agent-ccb6b77f; do [ -d "$d" ] && cd "$d" && break; done && npm run dev
